request: search_code: models often send a pattern without regex: true, e.g. "cursor-follower|link-hover|rotate\(45deg\)", which as literal text finds nothing ("No matches."). When a literal search finds nothing and the query has regex syntax (an escaped special character, an alternation, a wildcard), compiles as a regex, and can't match an empty line, search again as a regular expression. The result says so ("... searched as a regular expression ..."), with the usual "N matches in M file(s)" header and meta count; if that finds nothing either, the result starts with "No matches." and says it found nothing "as a regular expression either". "regex"/"case_sensitive" sent as the string "true" count as true.
